title: Crossy Road Directional Hop Frames
summary: 156 directional hop frames for all 13 agents. 4 directions x 3 frames each. Full movement coverage.
content:
Crossy Road Directional Hop Frames

13 agents x 4 directions (front, back, left, right) x 3 hop frames = 156 sprites at 128x128 transparent PNG.

Characters hop in ALL directions. No more scaleX(-1) hacks. Each direction has purpose-built art.

Directions

Front (South / Toward Camera)

  • Character faces the player
  • Full face visible: eyes, mouth, props
  • Default movement direction
  • File: {agent}-front-{frame}.png

Back (North / Away From Camera)

  • Character faces away
  • Hair covers back of head, no face visible
  • Head props (headphones, headset, scarf) still visible from behind
  • File: {agent}-back-{frame}.png

Left (West)

  • Character faces left, 3/4 view
  • Leading arm swings forward, trailing arm back
  • Slight body skew for perspective
  • Container uses scaleX(-1) of right-facing art internally
  • File: {agent}-left-{frame}.png

Right (East)

  • Character faces right, 3/4 view
  • Leading arm swings forward, trailing arm back
  • Slight body skew for perspective
  • File: {agent}-right-{frame}.png

Frame Sequence (Same as forward-only hop)

Frame: Ground

  • Neutral stance, full shadow (opacity 0.35, scale 1.0)
  • Normal proportions (scaleX: 1.0, scaleY: 1.0)

Frame: Peak

  • Character lifted 14px
  • Stretched (scaleX: 0.95, scaleY: 1.08)
  • Shadow compressed (opacity 0.2, scale 0.7)
  • Direction arrow indicator visible on ground
  • Aura at 50% (brighter at peak)

Frame: Landing

  • Character pushed down 2px
  • Squished wide (scaleX: 1.1, scaleY: 0.88)
  • Shadow expanded (opacity 0.45, scale 1.2)
  • Dust particles visible (4 circles)

File Map (156 total)

hop-directional/
  {agent}-front-ground.png    {agent}-front-ground.json
  {agent}-front-peak.png      {agent}-front-peak.json
  {agent}-front-landing.png   {agent}-front-landing.json
  {agent}-back-ground.png     {agent}-back-ground.json
  {agent}-back-peak.png       {agent}-back-peak.json
  {agent}-back-landing.png    {agent}-back-landing.json
  {agent}-left-ground.png     {agent}-left-ground.json
  {agent}-left-peak.png       {agent}-left-peak.json
  {agent}-left-landing.png    {agent}-left-landing.json
  {agent}-right-ground.png    {agent}-right-ground.json
  {agent}-right-peak.png      {agent}-right-peak.json
  {agent}-right-landing.png   {agent}-right-landing.json

For all 13 agents: patrik, mom, alex, steve, steffen, bobby, colton, cleo, tony, jacob, elmo, elon, pixel.

Bobby Integration

Loading directional sprites

const DIRECTIONS = ['front', 'back', 'left', 'right'];
const HOP_FRAMES = ['ground', 'peak', 'landing'];

function getHopSprite(agentId, direction, frame) {
  return `/assets/characters/crossy-road/hop-directional/${agentId}-${direction}-${frame}.png`;
}

// Determine direction from movement vector
function getDirection(dx, dy) {
  if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx)) {
    return dy > 0 ? 'front' : 'back';
  }
  return dx > 0 ? 'right' : 'left';
}

Animation timing

Same as forward-only: Ground (66ms) -> Peak (66ms) -> Landing (66ms) = 200ms per hop.

Preloading

Preload all 12 sprites per agent (4 dirs x 3 frames) on character spawn. Total memory: 156 x ~5KB = ~780KB for all agents. Acceptable.

Render Script

scripts/render-hop-directional.js

To regenerate:

node projects/steffen/scripts/render-hop-directional.js
